localFacts.fact: Canon Deutschland lists the EOS M50 Mark II at approx. 387 g (black) including battery and memory card (CIPA), the same figure as the English post.
Lufthansa allows one cabin bag of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm and 8 kg; the three full-size picks fold to 33 cm (Vanguard), 39,4 cm (Peak Design) and 39 cm (K&F), all shorter than 55 cm.
Kölner Dom (Domordnung): private photos without flash are allowed, but recordings with tripods need permission from the Dompropst.
Humboldt Forum Berlin allows private photos, but tripods may not be used indoors.
German terms: Stativkopf, Kugelkopf, Mittelsäule, Schnellwechselplatte, Stativgewinde 1/4 Zoll; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: Thin travel-tripod legs start to vibrate in light wind, so the maker's load rating says little.
localPainPoints.fix: The English post's point: the M50 Mark II kit is about 517 g, so choose on legs and column-down height; keep the column down and hang the bag on the hook (Vanguard, K&F).

quotes.text: Noch ein Tipp: Orientiere dich nicht an der Tragfähigkeit, die der Hersteller angibt.
Reisestative mit diesen dünnen Beinchen brechen nicht unter deiner Kamera zusammen. Aber sie fangen schon bei leichtem Wind an zu schwingen

localPainPoints.pain: Light tripods tip over in wind without extra weight.
localPainPoints.fix: Hang the bag from the hook under the column (the Vanguard has one; K&F has a small hook), spread the legs wide.

quotes.text: ich habe schon einige umgekippte Stative (samt Kamera und Optik) gesehen, die ohne Zusatzgewichte, bei gar nicht starkem Wind, sich verselbstständigt haben.

localGain.point: Lufthansa allows one cabin bag of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm and 8 kg check for the three full-size picks (33 / 39,4 / 39 cm folded).
M50 Mark II weight (387 g) cited from Canon's own German spec page; every height, length and load in metric first.
Maker metric figures for the minis: Manfrotto 20 cm / 20,5 cm / 0,26 kg / 2,5 kg for the PIXI EVO; JOBY 3 kg for the GorillaPod 3K.
